scientific_integrity: New theorem distinguishes classical Bernoulli/Faulhaber facts from its irreducible prime-power obstruction; no independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Higher moments only: s>=2 and k>s. The proof produces prime-power witnesses non-effectively rather than determining the least prime-power witness. The s=0,1 cases are excluded. The finite regression to exponent 20 is supplementary to a general symbolic argument. Literature coverage may miss unindexed equivalents.
title: Universal coprime power-sum divisibility is trivial beyond the first moment
